The market closed with a distinct bearish bias driven by persistent outflows and rising VIX volatility that signals deepening risk aversion among sophisticated players. A counter-trend long position is only justified if there is high conviction regarding exhaustion at support levels alongside a specific catalyst, never as a reflexive dip-buy in this regime.
